title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager: assess Azure, AWS and Google Cloud through Microsoft Defender for Cloud
summary: The summary promises that nothing happens until administrators set up the integration, but Microsoft has not documented that rollout behaviour for government tenants, including tenants already using Defender for Cloud. The roadmap facts, licensing discussion and documented navigation paths are supported; the cited Learn pages opened successfully.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans Compliance Manager integration with Defender for Cloud for resource-level testing and cloud-specific guidance across Microsoft 365, Azure, GCP and AWS.
claims.quote: Compliance Manager now integrates with Microsoft Defender for Cloud, allowing customers to assess their compliance posture across Microsoft 365, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and Amazon Web Services with resource-level testing and cloud-specific guidance.
